item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Consultant to support its ongoing efforts to enhance how capital projects are managed and how vendor performance is evaluated. Acting as an extension of the Program Administration team and reporting directly to the Director of Program Administration, the Consultant will assist with strengthening internal practices that support consistent, efficient, and accountable project delivery. This engagement supports a broader modernization initiative focused on improving workflows, documentation, project closeout, and data practices that support transparency, consistency, and informed decision-making.
